runtime.state: owned volume /var/lib/sftpgo: SQLite and native SSH host keys
runtime.files: owned volume /srv/sftpgo: users/<username> and shared/<folder>; no host paths
runtime.configuration: root-owned mode0440 files, group1000, mounted read-only /etc/pl-sftpgo
runtime.admin: random installation-private bootstrap account; native tokens only in controller memory
runtime.sftp: container2022; default host127.0.0.1:2022; explicit typed host-private-IPv4 listener plans
runtime.api: container8080; random host loopback port, no native web admin/client UI
runtime.client: session-bound native user JWT; never administrator impersonation
runtime.protocols: SFTP and private REST only; FTP/WebDAV/SSH commands disabled

required_acceptance: native SQLite/bootstrap/version/status and real SFTP handshake
password-only, SSH-key-only and independently enabled authentication
native groups, permissions, virtual folders, quotas and disabled-user rejection
Pl native user login, ACL-bound list/create/move/delete/upload/download
configuration revision conflict, listener preflight, interruption and rollback
disable/enable data persistence, client revocation, owned-only interrupted removal
image provenance and SCA; no tests or compatibility success inferred from metadata
